description: Retrieve annotation pins from the .feedback/ directory. Filter by page URL, LWC component name, or status. Use this to understand what feedback exists before making changes.

componentName.description: Filter by LWC component name. e.g. "wmlHomePage" or "c-wml-home-page"

critiqueRunId.description: Filter to pins from one exact Crit run for report read-back.

pageUrl.description: Filter by page URL (partial match OK). e.g. "WML_Care_Home"

pageUrls.description: Exact URLs to read in one batched critique lookup.

projectId.description: Project ID, required for the compact critique view.

view.description: Compact critique projection with selectors and bounded pin text.

name: get_annotations
title: Get Feedback Pins
